snippet.title: HOT TOPICS: Trump Goes Off the Rails Again as Racist Text Scandal Rocks Charlotte Police
snippet.description:
Donald Trump is making headlines for all the wrong reasons. From promising Americans $5,000 checks and handing out presidential pardons at campaign rallies to making bizarre claims about Social Security, the President's latest appearances are raising serious questions.
Plus, outrage after Trump shared footage of a deadly tiger attack, leaving a grieving British family devastated. 

Political commentator Adam Mockler joins Don to unpack the chaos, his showdown with Trump's new White House Press Secretary, and the growing questions surrounding the administration as the midterms approach.

And in Charlotte, North Carolina, a disturbing police scandal: Officers are facing possible termination over alleged racist text messages, including reports of a competition to see who could pull over the most Black drivers.

snippet.title: DILAPORKAN, GIBRAN TERANCAM TERSANGKA? Pakar Sebut Bisa Terjerat Pemalsuan Dokumen |iNews Prime14/10
snippet.description:
Wakil Presiden Gibran Rakabuming Raka kembali menjadi sorotan setelah dilaporkan ke Bareskrim Polri terkait dugaan pemalsuan atau penggunaan surat keterangan penyetaraan pendidikan dalam proses pencalonan Pilpres 2024.

Pengaduan tersebut diterima Bareskrim sebagai dumas dan akan ditindaklanjuti melalui proses penyelidikan. Objek yang dipersoalkan adalah surat keterangan penyetaraan pendidikan yang diterbitkan pada 2019 dan digunakan dalam proses pemenuhan persyaratan pencalonan wakil presiden. 

Pakar Hukum Pidana UMY Trisno Raharjo menyatakan dugaan pidana dapat menjangkau pihak yang meminta, membuat, menerbitkan hingga menggunakan dokumen apabila penyidik dapat membuktikan adanya pengetahuan dan kesengajaan. Menurutnya, pengguna dokumen tidak otomatis dapat dipidana jika tidak mengetahui adanya persoalan pada dokumen tersebut. 

Pakar hukum pidana Abdul Fickar Hadjar juga menilai putusan MK dapat menjadi bukti permulaan untuk mengusut perkara tersebut. Namun, proses hukum tetap harus melalui penyelidikan dan pembuktian oleh aparat penegak hukum.

Hingga kini, belum ada penetapan tersangka terhadap Gibran. Karena itu, istilah “terancam tersangka” masih merupakan kemungkinan hukum yang bergantung pada hasil penyelidikan dan bukti yang ditemukan penyidik.

snippet.title: Feds search Rep. Ilhan Omar's DC-area home: What we know
snippet.description:
Federal officers executed a search warrant early Monday at the Washington, DC-area home of Rep. Ilhan Omar, the Minnesota Democrat who has been the persistent target of ire from President Donald Trump’s administration, according to a Justice Department spokesperson and a source familiar with the matter. The congresswoman is running for reelection, and the search warrant was executed only weeks before the midterms.

The Department of Justice said in a statement Monday that investigators from Homeland Security Investigations, a branch of the Department of Homeland Security that handles criminal investigations, “executed a judicially authorized search warrant secured by the Department of Justice.” “This enforcement action is part of an ongoing federal criminal investigation,” a DOJ spokesperson said.

Omar called the search “the latest escalation” in Trump’s “campaign of political intimidation.”

snippet.title: POV: you catch the popular girls whispering about you

snippet.title: How Does SpaceX Catch a 230-Foot Rocket Out of the Air?
snippet.description:
The biggest rocket booster ever flown has no landing legs. Yet it flies home to the tower it launched from, stops in midair beside it about seven minutes after liftoff - and the tower catches it, the way chopsticks catch a fly.

A 3D engineering breakdown of how SpaceX's launch tower ("Mechazilla") catches Super Heavy, the booster under Starship. Super Heavy is about 71 m (233 ft) tall, roughly a 20-story building, and legs strong enough to land it would add tens of tons to every flight, so SpaceX left them off and let the tower catch it instead. After stage separation it flips and fires a boostback burn toward Texas. Before that burn ends, thousands of distinct vehicle and pad checks must pass and the Flight Director must send the go by hand; without it, the booster steers for a soft splashdown in the Gulf. It coasts to about 96 km (60 miles) up, then falls back engines first, steered by four grid fins of about 3 tonnes each - heavier than a pickup truck.

snippet.title: Scientists Entered the Mariana Trench — What They Discovered Is More Terrifying Than Space
snippet.description:
Scientists Entered the Mariana Trench — What They Discovered Is More Terrifying Than Space

Eleven kilometers beneath the Pacific lies the Mariana Trench, a place so deep that Mount Everest would vanish inside it, and so hostile that scientists once thought nothing could live there. In this video, we follow more than a decade of expeditions into that darkness and meet the creatures they found. You’ll discover a fish with a soft skull that lives against a depth limit nobody can explain, scavengers that build armor from aluminum, single cells the size of a mango, and whole communities that survive without sunlight. You’ll also see how our plastic, pollution and nuclear bomb carbon reached the deepest animals on Earth, and why this alien world matters for the search for life in space.
